subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 983 986 481 941 167 (Right)

(Example-697-First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7) (NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the third digit of the highest number is subtracted from the first digit of the lowest number?
solution:
Given: (Left) 983 986 481 941 167 (Right)

According to the question:

 
 

 Given numbers
 983
 986
 481
 941
 167
 
 

 Number are arranged in ascending order
 167
 481
 941
 983
 986
 
 

So,

Third digit of the highest number → 98__**6**__ → 6

First digit of the lowest number → __**1**__67 → 1

Thus, if the third digit of the highest number is subtracted from the first digit of the lowest number then the resultant will be → 1 - 6 → -5 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
